تعتبروا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَبِرُوا (taʕtabirū) /taʕ.ta.bi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# تُعْتَبَرُوا (tuʕtabarū) /tuʕ.ta.ba.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
